mapper.select: select pb.ID as id, /** 主键ID **/ pb.PRI_ID as priID, pb.INDEX_NAME as indexName, /** 指标名称**/ pb.INDEX_VALUE as indexValue, /**指标值**/ pb.INDEX_FILE as indexFile, /**指标值**/ pb.INDEX_TYPE as indexType, /**审核状态**/ pb.INDEX_DATE as indexDate, /**生效日期**/ pb.CREATE_USER as createUser, /** 制作人**/ to_char(pb.UPDATE_TIME,'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') as updateTimeFmt, pb.AUDIT_STATUS as auditStatus, /**审核状态**/ pb.INDEX_DETAIL as indexDetail /*适用范围说明*/ from REP_INDEX_SUB pb inner join REP_INDEX_PRIMARY py on pb.PRI_ID=py.ID where 1=1 AND py.id = #{indexId} ORDER BY pb.CREATE_TIME DESC
select ID as id, INDEX_NAME as indexName from REP_INDEX_SUB where INDEX_NAME =#{indexName}
mapper.insert: insert into REP_INDEX_SUB(ID,PRI_ID,INDEX_NAME,INDEX_VALUE, INDEX_DATE,INDEX_TYPE,INDEX_FILE, CREATE_USER,CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER,UPDATE_TIME,CREATE_DEPT,AUDIT_STATUS) values(#{id,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{priId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{indexName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{indexValue,jdbcType=CLOB}, to_date(#{indexDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), #{indexType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{indexFile,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '已审核')
mapper.select: select ris.ID as id,ris.PRI_ID as priId,ris.INDEX_NAME as indexName,ris.INDEX_VALUE as indexValue,ris.INDEX_DATE as indexDate, ris.INDEX_TYPE as indexType,to_char(ris.INDEX_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') as indexDateStr,ris.INDEX_FILE as indexFile,ris.INDEX_DETAIL as indexDetail, ris.AUDIT_STATUS as auditStatus,ris.END_DATE endDate,to_char(ris.END_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') as endDateStr, ris.INDEX_YEAR,ris.INDEX_PERIOD from REP_INDEX_SUB ris where ris.ID =#{id}
mapper.update:
update REP_INDEX_SUB
INDEX_NAME = #{indexName,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
INDEX_DATE = to_date(#{indexDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd'),
INDEX_VALUE = #{indexValue,jdbcType=CLOB},
INDEX_FILE = #{indexFile,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
INDEX_TYPE = #{indexType,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
UPDATE_TIME = sysdate,
where ID=#{id,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select: select rjr.RULE_TYPE1 as ruleType1, rjr.RULE_TYPE2 as ruleType2, rjr.RULE_TYPE3 as ruleType3, rjr.RULE_TYPE4 as ruleType4 from REP_JOB_RANGE rjr where rjr.JOB_ID=#{id,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select distinct PROD_ID id, PROD_NAME name, case PD_STATUS when '01' then (case ISSUING_WAY when '01' then '0101' || PROD_SERIES when '02' then '0102' || PROD_SERIES else '' end ) when '02' then (case ISSUING_WAY when '01' then '0201' || PROD_SERIES when '02' then '0202' || PROD_SERIES else '' end ) when '03' then (case ISSUING_WAY when '01' then '0301' || PROD_SERIES when '02' then '0302' || PROD_SERIES else '' end ) else '' end pid from V_REP_PROD_INFO where status='E' AND PROD_SERIES is not null

select distinct PROD_ID id, PROD_NAME name, case PD_STATUS when '01' then (case ISSUING_WAY when '01' then '0101' || PROD_SERIES when '02' then '0102' || PROD_SERIES else '' end ) when '02' then (case ISSUING_WAY when '01' then '0201' || PROD_SERIES when '02' then '0202' || PROD_SERIES else '' end ) when '03' then (case ISSUING_WAY when '01' then '0301' || PROD_SERIES when '02' then '0302' || PROD_SERIES else '' end ) else '' end pid from REP_PROD_INFO where status='E' AND PROD_SERIES is not null

SELECT distinct T1.PROD_ID id, nvl(T3.PROD_NAME,T2.PROD_NAME || '(' || T1.PROD_NAME || ')') name, case T1.PD_STATUS when '01' then (case T1.ISSUING_WAY when '01' then '0101' || T1.PROD_SERIES when '02' then '0102' || T1.PROD_SERIES else '' end ) when '02' then (case T1.ISSUING_WAY when '01' then '0201' || T1.PROD_SERIES when '02' then '0202' || T1.PROD_SERIES else '' end ) when '03' then (case T1.ISSUING_WAY when '01' then '0301' || T1.PROD_SERIES when '02' then '0302' || T1.PROD_SERIES else '' end ) else '' end pid FROM REP_PROD_INFO T1 left join REP_PROD_INFO T2 on T1.P_PROD_ID = T2.PROD_ID and T2.REP_PROD_TYPE = '01' left join REP_PROD_INFO T3 on T1.PROD_ID = T3.PROD_ID and T3.REP_PROD_TYPE = '02' where T1.P_PROD_ID is not null AND T1.STATUS not in ('D') AND T1.PROD_SERIES is not null AND T1.status='E'

select distinct T1.PROD_ID id, T1.PROD_NAME name, case T1.PD_STATUS when '01' then (case T1.ISSUING_WAY when '01' then '0101' || T1.PROD_SERIES when '02' then '0102' || T1.PROD_SERIES else '' end ) when '02' then (case T1.ISSUING_WAY when '01' then '0201' || T1.PROD_SERIES when '02' then '0202' || T1.PROD_SERIES else '' end ) when '03' then (case T1.ISSUING_WAY when '01' then '0301' || T1.PROD_SERIES when '02' then '0302' || T1.PROD_SERIES else '' end ) else '' end pid from V_REP_PROD_INFO T1 LEFT JOIN fin_product ON fin_product.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = T1.PROD_ID and fin_product.P_FINPROD_ID is null where T1.status='E' AND T1.PROD_SERIES is not null

select distinct prod.PROD_ID id, prod.PROD_ID || case when prod.REP_PROD_TYPE = '03' then pprod.PROD_NAME||'('||prod.PROD_NAME||')' else prod.PROD_NAME end name, case prod.PD_STATUS when '01' then (case prod.ISSUING_WAY when '01' then '0101' || prod.PROD_SERIES || to_char(case when prod.REP_PROD_TYPE = '03' then pprod.PROD_NAME||'('||prod.PROD_NAME||')' else prod.PROD_NAME end) when '02' then '0102' || prod.PROD_SERIES || to_char(case when prod.REP_PROD_TYPE = '03' then pprod.PROD_NAME||'('||prod.PROD_NAME||')' else prod.PROD_NAME end) else '' end ) when '02' then (case prod.ISSUING_WAY when '01' then '0201' || prod.PROD_SERIES || to_char(case when prod.REP_PROD_TYPE = '03' then pprod.PROD_NAME||'('||prod.PROD_NAME||')' else prod.PROD_NAME end) when '02' then '0202' || prod.PROD_SERIES || to_char(case when prod.REP_PROD_TYPE = '03' then pprod.PROD_NAME||'('||prod.PROD_NAME||')' else prod.PROD_NAME end) else '' end ) when '03' then (case prod.ISSUING_WAY when '01' then '0301' || prod.PROD_SERIES || to_char(case when prod.REP_PROD_TYPE = '03' then pprod.PROD_NAME||'('||prod.PROD_NAME||')' else prod.PROD_NAME end) when '02' then '0302' || prod.PROD_SERIES || to_char(case when prod.REP_PROD_TYPE = '03' then pprod.PROD_NAME||'('||prod.PROD_NAME||')' else prod.PROD_NAME end) else '' end ) else '' end pid from REP_PROD_INFO prod left join V_REP_PROD_INFO pprod on prod.p_prod_id = pprod.prod_id where prod.rep_prod_type in ('02','03') AND prod.PROD_SERIES is not null and prod.STATUS = 'E'

select distinct PROD_ID id, PROD_ID || PROD_NAME name, case PD_STATUS when '01' then (case ISSUING_WAY when '01' then '0101' || PROD_SERIES || to_char(PROD_NAME) when '02' then '0102' || PROD_SERIES || to_char(PROD_NAME) else '' end ) when '02' then (case ISSUING_WAY when '01' then '0201' || PROD_SERIES || to_char(PROD_NAME) when '02' then '0202' || PROD_SERIES || to_char(PROD_NAME) else '' end ) when '03' then (case ISSUING_WAY when '01' then '0301' || PROD_SERIES || to_char(PROD_NAME) when '02' then '0302' || PROD_SERIES || to_char(PROD_NAME) else '' end ) else '' end pid from REP_PROD_INFO where status='E' and PROD_SERIES is not null and p_prod_id is not null

select distinct d.PROD_ID id, d.PROD_ID || r.PROD_NAME name, case r.PD_STATUS when '01' then (case r.ISSUING_WAY when '01' then '0101' || r.PROD_SERIES || to_char(r.PROD_NAME) when '02' then '0102' || r.PROD_SERIES || to_char(r.PROD_NAME) else '' end ) when '02' then (case r.ISSUING_WAY when '01' then '0201' || r.PROD_SERIES || to_char(r.PROD_NAME) when '02' then '0202' || r.PROD_SERIES || to_char(r.PROD_NAME) else '' end ) when '03' then (case r.ISSUING_WAY when '01' then '0301' || r.PROD_SERIES || to_char(r.PROD_NAME) when '02' then '0302' || r.PROD_SERIES || to_char(r.PROD_NAME) else '' end ) else '' end pid FROM DIS_LARGE_REDEMPTION d left join rep_prod_info r on d.PROD_ID = r.PROD_ID where status='E' and PROD_SERIES is not null

select count(1) from REP_INDEX_SUB r1 where r1.PRI_ID = #{priId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND r1.INDEX_DETAIL = #{indexDetail,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and (r1.INDEX_DATE <= #{indexDate,jdbcType=DATE} and r1.END_DATE >= #{indexDate,jdbcType=DATE} ) or ( r1.INDEX_DATE <= #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} and r1.INDEX_DATE >= #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} )
